body:
Equations and conventions supplied in BOUNDARY-REPLY.md; no code or numerical rerun. The stated constant forced-convection setup differs from the filed boundary: h is the maximum of forced convection and 1.32 max(abs(To-Ta), 0.05)^0.25. Forced convection uses diameter 2R and velocity 2 m/s, without a viscosity-ratio multiplier.

Sky/ground fractions are (1+mu)/2 and (1-mu)/2. Ground is 284.9 K; day/night sky is 275/260 K, solar 970/0 W/m². Inner qi = 0.2 sigma [Ti^4 - area_mean(Ti^4)]. U = 130(rho_core/rho_Al)/tc + 0.2*4sigma*area_mean(Ti)^3, and To = Ti + qi/U. Both radiative terms are present. Common aluminium density 2700 differs from legacy 2640 kg/m³.

The attachment supplies normalized averages, the complete outer balance, current 128-point iteration tolerances and legacy 37-midpoint/25-update conventions. Current structural mean removal precedes degree 2–6 projection; absolute radiation temperatures are retained. It distinguishes original 037 finite-difference curvature from the later legacy diagnostic.

Already-filed common reference values are copied with selectors: 302.024817534/270.905193616 K and daytime gradient 0.422761140 K. Six owner-source pins match filed manifests. Natural convection and conductance are candidate causes, not a demonstrated quantitative closure of every discrepancy. Independent thermal reproduction and physical-boundary NFIs remain open. Question answered; no further request.
